reviews.text: Let me start with we don't have a pool... however, I was picking up food next door and my 1.5 year old was losing his mind when I put him back in the car, because he wanted dinner NOW. The owner of this store came out and offered some fruit snacks to calm him and make the car ride home easier. He went out of his way to help this tired momma and hangry toddler, and it encouraged me. Thank you, and if I ever get a pool, I'll definitely be shopping here just based off this interaction.

We have been happy customers of All About Pools in Rowlett for many years.  These folks are terrific, and their family owned business is one of the best.  Customer Service is impeccable.  When we need pool advice, we call or go see Dan.  He is the best resource of pool knowledge we have found.  We buy all of our pool products and parts and supplies from this business.  The Service Department is excellent.  They determine the problem immediately and repairs are prompt and painless.  I trust them

Dan has been great and very knowledgeable to deal with.  I knew my salt cell went bad and i had a system that the company was no longer around.  He got me setup with a new salt cell system and explained it very well.  It took me a month to pull the trigger and the many phone calls to him, he was always pleasant and very helpful and insightful.  I highly recommend him and his establishment for all your pool needs.

Great service, take my water there on Saturday for testing and can get everything i need.  They have also serviced my pool equipment. Couple of weeks ago i had some landscaping done in backyard pool area, then yesterday evening went out for an evening swim and lights didnt woork. I  called about my pool lights not working and to see if I could get a tech scheduled to come and troubleshoot and fix the issue. The owner had answered my call and after explaing everything to him, he says before we go

We have a 40,000-gallon saltwater pool that we now maintain ourselves and that’s entirely thanks to All About Pools in Rowlett! Before finding them, we had gone through several pool companies who saw our pool as just a money pit. The service was inconsistent, overpriced, and frustrating.

Then we found All About Pools — and everything changed. Dan, the owner, is truly one of a kind. He’s honest, knowledgeable, and incredibly patient. He took the time to educate us on every aspect of our pool, fr

Dan was very helpful with my pool issue. Everything he told me was spot on. You will not find a better pool store.
Thanks for the great service!!

Trying to learn the correct way to maintain my pool was overwhelming to me.  However, Dan, at All About Pools, has been so helpful in answering all of my questions and teaching me how to properly care for my pool.  It is obvious he has extensive experience in this line of work and I highly recommend this business.

Dan was very helpful in assisting me fix my pool issues. This is an honest company that cares about their customers and not just making the most profit. Will be taking the drive to Rowlett for all my pool needs from now on.

This shop takes care of its customers.  They are partners with a genuine interest in making sure your pool is beautiful and ready to host swimmers.  We had a pretty serious recovery operation to perform on our parent’s pool and the owner walked us through the process of rehabilitating the pumps, filters, and getting the right chemical balance in the water.  We followed instructions and the results were incredible. They don’t spend any money on advertising, so the savings are passed to the custom

These guys are great. They really pay attention to the details and it's a family owned business. I love that they get to know all their customers on a personal level and they know your name when you see them. I can't think of many businesses that would do as much for a customer as this family and they work to make sure that you are 100% satisfied. We love using our pool and these guys really make sure that it's a great experience. Now that it's warming up we are ready to get back in the water! T
Best pool company, family owned and operated. They dont try to upsell you at all and really care about your pool! I moved and still drive to this store! Free water test!!

We started the 2024 season with a heater that had eroded and was leaking at the coil.  I reached out to several sources and received some crazy recommendations without any real understanding of our needs.

Ultimately we found All About Pools.  Dan went out of his way to understand our pool, and discuss the different options to properly provide the heater we needed at a great price.  We ended up buying a Raypak AVIA with a Nitek coil.  We are so happy with the purchase and are now able to control

We have been customers with Dan Dan the pool man as we like to call him for about 11 years!! He is an amazing Pool doctor. Not only does he help us with our current pool, he takes care of the maintenance on our rental house pool. We could not have done it without him! He is so friendly and professional. we still drive from Heath to get our water checked by Dan. whether it is mechanical or chemical, he takes care of it! he is also very organized with his billing for monthly maintenance. we seriou

Dan at All about Pools is fantastic.  He always greets me with a smile and always is knowledgeable.  He tests my water to help solve issues before they become problems.
We had a cleaner for our pool that the builder provided.  It broke and Dan didn't blink an eye at helping us with the warranty and ultimately getting us a brand new pool cleaner.  I can't say enough great things about Dan and All About Pools.  Anything you need, go see him.  Support small businesses, you won't be sorry you do.
Dan takes care of his customers without hesitation and with heart. God bless you.

Trying to find a company you can trust? All About Pools is your place. The entire family, that I have met, are wonderful. And very helpful. They have explained things to me and helped with my pool. Thank you Dan and family. Tamra

All About Pools has maintained our equipment, provided spare parts, and offered expert advice for the past 6-1/2 years.  Very pleased with the attentive service when our pumps needed replacement after 2021 freeze.  Dan has expertly reworked our Polaris cleaner on several occasions, enabling it to remain operable and avoiding the cost of outright replacement.  Regular water testing and chemical adjustments by service personnel have kept our pool in great condition.

We transferred our pool maintenance service to All About Pools in May 2020 and immediately noticed a positive difference in the quality of customer service & care that we received. Every contact from this family owned business was professional, informative, and pleasant. Sarah, the Accounts Mgr is cheerful and very helpful each time I call. Nathan, our pool tech is very detailed in the maintenance of our pool and is always on time. Jeremy, our repair professional is phenomenal... putting it ligh

Dan at All-about pools is the most knowledgeable pool technician when it comes to the working mechanics of a swimming pool. He also is the best I’ve ever experienced on evaluating the water chemistry. By no doubt, all about Pools is the best most professional, knowledgeable and friendly pool store I have ever experienced. Thank you all about Pools!!
RH

The team at All About Pools have been nothing but great for us.  They’re knowledgeable, kind, and honest.  They love kids and treat us with high respect.  Thanks for all the work you do for the community and our members!

reviews.text: We have been happy customers of All About Pools in Rowlett for many years.  These folks are terrific, and their family owned business is one of the best.  Customer Service is impeccable.  When we need pool advice, we call or go see Dan.  He is the best resource of pool knowledge we have found.  We buy all of our pool products and parts and supplies from this business.  The Service Department is excellent.  They determine the problem immediately and repairs are prompt and painless.  I trust them implicitly.  My husband and I recommend All About Pools exclusively.  We are selling our home and are building a new one, without a pool.  I can tell you, we will miss visiting with Dan.  He’s always friendly and eager to share a few words.  Wanda, Dan and the gang rate highly in our book.  We are telling the buyers of our home to do all their pool business at All About Pools. Thanks Y’all for many happy years of association!

reviews.text: Dan has been great and very knowledgeable to deal with.  I knew my salt cell went bad and i had a system that the company was no longer around. reviews.text: Great service, take my water there on Saturday for testing and can get everything i need.  They have also serviced my pool equipment. reviews.text:
We have a 40,000-gallon saltwater pool that we now maintain ourselves and that’s entirely thanks to All About Pools in Rowlett! Before finding them, we had gone through several pool companies who saw our pool as just a money pit. The service was inconsistent, overpriced, and frustrating.

Then we found All About Pools — and everything changed. Dan, the owner, is truly one of a kind. He’s honest, knowledgeable, and incredibly patient. He took the time to educate us on every aspect of our pool, from equipment to water chemistry, and gave us the confidence to maintain it ourselves. Dan genuinely cares about his customers and goes above and beyond to help, no pressure, no upselling, just real help from someone who knows what he’s doing.

Because of Dan and his team, we actually enjoy our pool again.

Personally I think, If you’re tired of overpriced pool services and want to work with someone who actually cares, call All About Pools. You’ll be glad you did.

data.summary: Reviews are overwhelmingly authentic with strong, specific praise for the owner's knowledge and customer service. The primary anomaly is the duplication of 8 reviews across two Google listings, which suggests some review management but not widespread fakery. No substantive complaints found.
fake_signals: Identical reviews posted on two different Google listings
One review is from a non-customer (fruit snacks story)

positive_evidence: Owner educated customer on pool maintenance

authentic_signals: Specific project details (salt cell replacement, 40,000-gallon pool, pool lights)
Consistent mention of owner 'Dan' and his expertise
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are consistently high across Google (4.6) and Yelp (4.2). BBB A+ rating indicates good complaint handling. No significant discrepancies.
